headline: Unlinking every issue deletes the case; XDR agent 9.3 and 9.2 added to the mobile support tables
summary_md:
- **Linking issues to cases** gains a warning: unlink the last issue and the case itself is deleted.
- **Mobile operating systems supported with Cortex XDR** adds Cortex XDR agent 9.3 and 9.2 columns to both the Android and the iOS/iPadOS table.
- **CSP onboarding** now lists manual onboarding for Azure alongside AWS and GCP, and renames the automated path to Infrastructure as Code.
- The remaining two changes are housekeeping: a duplicated icon table removed and a link title typo fixed.
- Five pages in total, none added, removed or renamed.

highlights.title: Unlinking all issues from a case deletes the case
highlights.detail: A new warning hint on the link/unlink page states the case is deleted once its last issue is unlinked, which the page did not previously say.

highlights.title: Manual CSP onboarding is now available for Azure
highlights.detail: The note limiting manual onboarding to AWS and GCP now reads AWS, Azure and GCP, and the automated alternative is described as provisioning resources from an Infrastructure as Code template.

highlights.title: Cortex XDR agent 9.3 and 9.2 join the mobile compatibility tables
highlights.detail: Both tables gain two columns; Android 26 and iOS 26 are marked supported on 9.3 and 9.2, and the existing 9.1 through 8.8 rows are unchanged.

items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: Adds a warning that a case is deleted when all of its issues are unlinked.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Manual onboarding is now documented for AWS, Azure and GCP; the automated deployment method is restated as an IaC template.
items.compatibility/where-can-i-install-the-co: Android and iOS/iPadOS support tables extended with Cortex XDR agent 9.3 and 9.2 columns.
items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: The event icons table was published twice; the duplicate is removed and its AI icon row kept in the table that remains.
Link text corrected from "Create a graph rules" to "Create a graph rule".
